source.testName: Build case studies showcase with tiles

prompt: Build a case studies showcase page for Contoso's Customer Success Stories. Add a Text web part for the introduction: 'See How Leading Organizations Transform with Contoso' - Our customers across healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and retail are achieving remarkable results with our platform. Include a Quick Links web part titled 'Featured Case Studies' with tile layout containing links to: 'Acme Healthcare: 50% Faster Patient Onboarding' -> https://contoso.com/cases/acme-healthcare, 'Global Bank: $10M Saved in Compliance Costs' -> https://contoso.com/cases/global-bank, 'MegaManufacturing: 99.9% Production Uptime' -> https://contoso.com/cases/mega-manufacturing, 'RetailCo: 30% Increase in Customer Satisfaction' -> https://contoso.com/cases/retailco, 'TechStart: Scaled from 10 to 10,000 Users' -> https://contoso.com/cases/techstart, and 'EduFirst: Transformed Remote Learning' -> https://contoso.com/cases/edufirst. Add a Text web part inviting visitors to submit their own success story.

checks.text: Page should contain exactly 1 Quick Links web part
Page should contain exactly 1 Quick Links web part
Quick Links web part should have Tiles layout
Page should contain exactly 2 Text web part(s)

policy.scope: One new draft page through the requested bottom-right Copilot control. Do not edit CollabHome, publish, send messages or follow external test links.
policy.inputs: Preserve exact prompt and all four supplied checks. IDs are source coordinates assigned for traceability, not original assertion IDs.
policy.evidence: Capture original chat response and generated page using natural user scrolling; use visible editor properties or read-only page structure to verify web-part counts and layout. Unavailable structure is UNABLE, not a visual guess.
policy.scoring: PASS/(PASS+FAIL); coverage=(PASS+FAIL)/(PASS+FAIL+UNABLE). Preserve the duplicated check in the supplied denominator and disclose it. No applicable checks means not scored.
policy.observations: Content accuracy against the prompt, link labels/targets and visual quality are separate unscored observations, not silently added assertions. Synthetic Contoso claims are not verified real-world facts.
policy.limitations: One structural case does not establish overall page-creation quality. No new source-generation or assertion-generation benchmark is implied.
